ABOUT SCORCHED EARTH

Small shop. Serious chillies.

Scorched Earth Seeds is an independent chilli seed shop built around a genuine obsession with growing unusual and seriously hot varieties.

The range is deliberately mixed: familiar favourites for getting started, proper superhots for experienced growers, and varieties chosen because they look, taste or grow differently.

Every order is packed by Scorched Earth Seeds. The goal is simple: help you grow something worth showing off.
